sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.body: "MT Report Viewer" (the "Service") is a web application that aggregates and visualizes MT4/MT5 trade reports. This policy explains what user information we collect, how we use it, and how we manage it.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
items: Email address and password (for authentication)
MT4/MT5 trade history (timestamps, symbols, P/L, etc.)
Account information (balance, equity, credit)
Open position information

sections.title: 3. How we use your information
sections.body: We only use the information for:
items: Aggregating and displaying your trading results
Authentication and login management
Improving the Service and fixing issues
sections.note: We never share or sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Data storage
sections.body: Data is stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL). Each user can only view and modify their own data, enforced via Row Level Security. The operator may access data for service operation and incident response.

sections.title: 5. Retention and deletion
sections.body: If you wish to delete your account, you can do so from inside the app or by contacting us. Deleted data cannot be recovered.

sections.title: 6. Security
sections.body: Data is transmitted over encrypted (HTTPS) connections, and passwords are stored encrypted. We cannot, however, guarantee absolute security on the internet.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and local storage
sections.body: The Service uses browser local storage for session management. We do not use tracking for advertising.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may be changed without prior notice. We will announce material changes inside the app.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related questions, use the "Contact" link at the bottom of the page or email devtomoki9@gmail.com.

intro.heading: What MT Report Viewer is
intro.body: An app that automatically uploads your MT4 / MT5 trade reports to the cloud, so you can manage multiple accounts from a single browser. An EA on your PC writes the data, a PowerShell script picks up changes and uploads instantly, and the browser receives updates over Supabase Realtime — making the dashboard near-real-time.
intro.prerequisitesBody: This app assumes one account per MT4/MT5 instance and one EA per account. Logging multiple accounts into a single instance, or attaching multiple EAs to the same account, is not supported.

login.title: Sign in
steps: Enter your email and password and click "Sign in"

section2.heading: 2. First-time setup (PC side)
section2.intro: After signing in, the setup screen shows download buttons for each file you'll need.

step1.title: Install the EA
step1.body: Download install.bat, MT4ReportExporter.mq4, and MT5ReportExporter.mq5 into the same folder, then run them in PowerShell.

step2.title: Configure MT4/MT5
step2.body: install.bat will launch MT4/MT5 automatically. In each window that opens, do the following:
mt4Steps: File → New Chart → choose any symbol
Navigator → Experts → drag MT4ReportExporter onto the chart → OK
File → Profiles → Save As → name it MTExporter → OK
mt5Steps: File → New Chart → choose any symbol
Navigator → Experts → drag MT5ReportExporter onto the chart → OK
File → Profiles → Save As → name it MTExporter → OK
step2.footnote: * If you use both MT4 and MT5, repeat this in each window.

step3.title: Set up the sync script
step3.body1: Download sync-to-supabase.ps1 and run-sync.vbs into the same folder (e.g. Downloads).
step3.body2: When you download run-sync.vbs you'll be prompted for a password. Enter your login password — it gets embedded in the file along with your connection details.
step3.body3: * The Task Scheduler command below assumes Downloads. If you saved the files elsewhere, update the path in the command.

step4.title: Register the scheduled task
step4.body: Set up a task that watches for file changes and uploads them in real time. Run this in PowerShell:

step1.title: Launching MT4/MT5
step1.body: After setup, always launch MT4/MT5 from the desktop's MT_Exporter.bat. The EA loads automatically and writes JSON files to %USERPROFILE%\MTExport\.

step2.title: Viewing reports
step2.body: Open the app in your browser and sign in — your data loads automatically. If nothing shows up, click ↻ Refresh in the top right.

step3.title: Live updates
step3.body: Thanks to Supabase Realtime, the dashboard updates almost instantly when MT4/MT5 writes new data. Click ↻ Refresh if you want to force an immediate update.

section4.heading: 4. The screens
screens: Combined balance, floating P/L, net profit, win rate, PF, equity curve, and open positions across all accounts
AI diagnosis, score cards, recommendations, per-account recommendations, and winning-pattern analysis. Free plan shows 1 diagnosis item; the rest is Pro-only

items: Sign out: top-right email/plan badge → dropdown → "Sign out"

eaParams.heading: EA parameter control (Pro)
eaParams.scope: Scope: only EAs whose source (.mq4/.mq5) you own. EAs you only have as compiled .ex4/.ex5 binaries (e.g. commercial EAs) are not supported, because MT4/5 provides no API for an external program to read or write another EA's input values.
eaParams.body: Add MTReportViewerParams.mqh to your EA's source, recompile, and you can change its inputs remotely from the form inside each expanded account card. The same EA running on EURUSD and USDJPY shows up as separate entries.
eaParams.shadowNote: MQL input variables cannot be reassigned at runtime, so use a two-variable pattern: the input holds the initial value, and a regular variable is what the EA mutates. The example below copies Lot_ (input) into Lot (mutable) at startup before registering it.
eaParams.note: Changes take a few seconds to propagate. The sync script must be running on the MT terminal machine.

section7.heading: 7. Contact
section7.body: For questions or bug reports, use the "Contact" link at the bottom of the page.

sync.intro: If data isn't showing up or isn't updating, try the steps below in order.

items.title: Click the ↻ Refresh button
items.body: ↻ Refresh in the top right pulls the latest data from the server immediately. Try this first.

items.title: Are you launching MT4/MT5 from MT_Exporter.bat?
items.body: MT4/MT5 needs to be launched from MT_Exporter.bat on the desktop — not from a regular shortcut.
items.body2: Launching from the regular shortcut skips the EA, so no JSON files are written.

items.title: Check whether JSON files are being written
items.body: Open the folder below in Explorer and confirm JSON files exist:
items.body2: If nothing's there, the EA isn't running correctly. Check the "Experts" tab in MT4/MT5 for error logs.

items.title: Check that Task Scheduler is running
items.body: From the Start menu, search for "Task Scheduler" and look for a task named MTExportSync.
items: Status should be Ready
Last Run Result should be The operation completed successfully. (0x0)
items.body2: If the task doesn't exist, recreate it with this command:

items.title: Did you change your password recently?
items.body: run-sync.vbs has your login password baked in. If you change your password, the old one stops working and the sync stalls.
items.body2: From the dashboard's setup screen, re-download run-sync.vbs and replace the file in Task Scheduler.

items.title: Unblock the PowerShell script
items.body: Windows security may block downloaded PowerShell scripts. Run this in PowerShell:
items.body2: If it still won't run, change the execution policy from an elevated PowerShell:

items.title: Only some trades show up in the detailed report
items.body: If the Account History tab in MT4/MT5 is limited to a date range, the EA can only export trades within that range.
items: Open the Account History tab in MT4/MT5's bottom panel
Right-click the trade list
Choose All History from the menu
items.body3: Once you select All History, the next sync will pick up everything.

items.title: I deleted an account card but it keeps coming back
items.body: The ✕ button on a card deletes the account's data on the server too.
items.body2: However, if the sync script is still running, MT4/MT5 will re-upload it next time it exports.
items.body3: To stop a specific account from showing up entirely:
items: Stop that account's EA (MT4ReportExporter / MT5ReportExporter) inside MT4/MT5
Delete the JSON file for that account number from the folder below
items.body4: JSON filenames include the account number (e.g. 12345678.json). After deleting the file, click the ✕ button on the card to remove the data on the server.

ea.intro: Settings related to how the EA runs.

items.title: Change the data update interval
items.body: The EA parameter RealtimeSec sets the minimum export interval (in seconds) when ticks come in.
options: If you want to reduce load
items.body2: How to change: double-click the EA on the chart in MT4/MT5 → Inputs tab → edit RealtimeSec → OK. Values below 5 seconds are clamped to 5 internally.

items.title: Change the periodic export interval
items.body: Even when no ticks come in, the EA exports periodically based on RefreshMinutes. Default is 1 minute.
items.body2: How to change: double-click the EA on the chart → Inputs tab → edit RefreshMinutes → OK.

items.title: Forgot my password
items.body: Click "Forgot your password?" on the sign-in screen and enter your email — a reset email will be sent.
items.body2: If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.

items.title: Confirmation email never arrived
items.body: If the sign-up confirmation email isn't arriving, check your spam folder. If it's still missing, wait a bit and try signing up again.

items.title: Still showing as Free after paying
items.body: Webhook processing can take a few seconds. Click ↻ Refresh in the top right to see if your plan has updated.
items.body2: If nothing changes after a few minutes, please contact us.

items.title: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.body: Top-right account menu (your email) → Manage subscription lets you cancel.
items.body2: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period — you keep Pro features until then.

items.title: If I delete my account, does the subscription cancel too?
items.body: Yes. When you delete a Pro account, your Lemon Squeezy subscription is canceled automatically.

items.title: Where can I find receipts and invoices?
items.body: Account menu → Manage subscription opens the Lemon Squeezy customer portal, where you can view and download past invoices and receipts.
